# Cliff-spill regression inputs

`field_before.gd` is the production water field saved before September 15 issue 05. It is used only to regenerate matched before evidence.

`shore_before.bin` contains primitive `fill`, `fill_base`, `storeys`, `levels` and `carved` values for the September 10 photo 16 geography, chunk (3,-10), seed 2697992464, evaluated with that pre-issue-05 field. It is generated by `september15_water_drop_legacy_probe.gd`. No executable objects are serialized.

The three existing free-shore interpolation regressions retain this input and call the **current** `WaterField` interpolation. Their original shoreline-count, entry-depth and continuity limits are unchanged. The new production crest support intentionally replaces that inland shoreline with a connected spill; a separate live-field regression checks the complete 15 m approach/descent, unchanged dry high bank, and continuity. This separation preserves coverage of genuinely dry shores without requiring an artificial dry strip at a supplied outlet.
